name: Macro credit-spread stress de-risk — long crypto only when credit is calm
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (orthogonal to every existing spec — credit_spread is used by NOTHING in the inbox): corporate credit spreads (BAA-AAA / IG OAS) are the canonical leading indicator of systemic financial stress — they widen BEFORE equity and crypto draw down because credit markets price default/liquidity risk first. A widening spread is the bond market flashing risk-off; a tight, stable spread is a green light for the whole risk complex. Crypto, as the highest-beta risk asset, suffers most when credit stress hits, so conditioning a crypto long on a NON-WIDENING credit regime is a clean, causally-motivated macro filter no crypto-native signal captures. Entry: credit_spread below a fitted calm ceiling (no systemic stress) AND price in a non-broken uptrend. Exit: credit_spread crosses UP through a stress threshold (credit is widening — the bond market is de-risking, so do we) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the unconditional trend long matches the deflated Sharpe, the credit gate adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: credit_spread, vix_level and yield_curve all proxy the macro stress regime; if substituting vix_level does as well this is macro-vix-calm re-skinned — the credit channel must add orthogonal information (credit leads equity vol). Disconfirmer 3 (cost): conditional long must beat buy-and-hold deflated Sharpe net of ~20bps. tier0 macro feature, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: corporate credit spreads calm and not widening — no systemic stress for a crypto long
